_comment: Which side a news domain reports from, for adversarial corroboration.
The principle (William's, 31 Aug 2026): two sources agreeing is weak when
they share incentives, strong when they do not. Five Telegram channels all
reporting a Ukrainian strike is one perspective repeated. RT and the Kyiv
Independent both reporting that a Moscow warehouse burned is evidence,
because neither side gains from conceding it.
IMPORTANT: adversarial agreement corroborates THAT SOMETHING HAPPENED. It
does not corroborate the weapon, the target, the attribution or the
casualty count — those are exactly what the two sides will disagree about.
Promote the event; never promote the parsed fields.
'side' is about reporting position in THIS war, not about quality. The
Kyiv Independent is a good newspaper and is still on one side of it.
Editorial file. William reviews. Unlisted domains are treated as 'unknown'
and count for nothing until classified.
_note_on_third_party: Meduza, Novaya Gazeta Europe and the Moscow Times are Russian outlets
operating in exile and banned in Russia. They are not Russian state media
and they are not Ukrainian. Third party is the honest slot for them, but
it is a judgement call and it is yours to overrule.

rules.corroborated: TWO SIDES agree the event occurred, or one third-party wire reports it. Because both Telegram channels are Ukrainian-aligned, a matching Russian-state article is itself an adversarial pair.
rules.confirmed: a body with jurisdiction confirms it, or physical evidence supports it
rules.verified: a professional dataset (ACLED, UCDP) has recorded it - not yet reachable
rules._scope: Promotion applies to WHETHER THE EVENT OCCURRED. It never promotes the parsed weapon, target or casualty figures - those are precisely what opposing sources disagree about.

_note_on_channels: Both channels currently feeding the site report from the Ukrainian side.
That is why no event has ever been corroborated by a second channel: there
is only one perspective in the pool, arriving twice. A Russian-side or
third-party channel would change this immediately.
